*Reposting for visibility*!!! $2050 April 1 Move In East Village Sublet!
Please reach out asap on Facebook Messenger and we can shift to iMessage from there!

Hi!!! I’m looking for a roommate to join me and my wonderful dachshund, Apollo, in my amazing 2 bedroom, 1 bathroom East Village apartment located on the corner of E 11th Street and Ave C. We’re on the 4th floor of a walk up building and have in-unit laundry! Queer friendly roommates only! 

More about me — I’m 25, from Connecticut, and have lived in the East Village for ~6 years (coming up on 4 years in this apartment!). In addition to spending time with Apollo, I love exercising (weight lifting, Pilates, yoga, running), discussing philosophy, exploring spirituality, going to the movies, hanging out in Tompkins Square Park and trying new restaurants. I’m open to living with women, non-binary people and queer men. No smokers or vape users (THC or nicotine). 

My current roommate is moving out at the end of the month, so you can move in on April 1 and I’m flexible with sublease end dates (but prefer long term). The apartment lease will renew on June 1 and rent per person may go up $25-$50 dollars. 

Please note that the room will come unfurnished. The room offers a double rack closet, a massive storage shelf above the closet, and enough room for a desk, dresser, and full or queen size bed depending on your needs. I will need to store my AC unit on the storage shelf when not in use as I have nowhere else to put it. 

Monthly utilities are usually $50-$75 per person when AC isn’t being used, and $100-$125 with AC (we’ll do our best to be energy efficient)!

Prior to moving in, I’ll need April Rent ($2050) and a Security Deposit ($2050). I’ll draft up a sublease agreement and ensure we’re on the same page across the board!
